title: Assistant agentic MCP tool descriptor registry

criteria.statement: internal/mcp exposes ToolDescriptor values that wrap existing MCP Tool definitions and carry execution-mode, effect, default-risk, resource-type, and resource-id-field metadata using the domain-owned assistant tool types.
AssistantToolRegistry discovers current agent-safe MCP tools without changing Server.GetTools or Server.CallTool public behavior.

Existing assistant, DNS, service, LLM, and ML tools have descriptor metadata; public mutation tools that are not assistant-safe remain discoverable as descriptors but are excluded from agent-safe discovery.
Unit tests assert descriptor mode/effect/risk/resource correctness and verify descriptors wrap the current GetTools definitions.
